system_instruction:
[STRUCTURAL DECOUPLING, GEOMETRY LOCK & STATIC RECTIFICATION CONTRACT]
- GEOMETRY LOCK: Treat all architectural geometry as an immutable physical frame. Every column, window recess, sash mullion, cornice, balustrade, and ashlar course must remain razor-sharp and structurally intact. Zero geometric melting, AI smoothing, or warping.
- STATIC DECLUTTERING (MANDATORY): COMPLETELY ERASE all transient vehicles, parked cars, delivery vans, pedestrians, wheelie bins, and temporary street clutter from the seed image. Repaint the carriageway with authentic road surfacing, whinstone kerbs, and clean flagstone pavements.
- BOTANICAL PHENOLOGY & CANOPY INTEGRITY (IMMUTABLE): Zero summer hallucinations during winter/dormant dates. Render true deciduous defoliation, bare branch ramification, and species-specific dormancy:
  Drummond Place Gardens internal parkland enclave dominated by mature canopy trees: *Acer pseudoplatanus* (Sycamore), *Fagus sylvatica* (European Beech), *Ulmus glabra* (Wych Elm), and *Tilia × europaea* (Common Lime). Phenological state for November 11: Advanced late-autumn defoliation (~85% leaf drop), revealing dense dark skeletal branching structures, intricate crown ramifications, and lingering clusters of desiccated ochre, russet, and dull yellow marcescent leaves. Understorey features trimmed turf covered in moist brown leaf litter and clipped *Taxus baccata* and *Ilex aquifolium* evergreen perimeter shrubs.
- OPTICAL FIDELITY: Pin-sharp infinite depth of field (f/11). Zero lens blur, tilt-shift, or depth-of-field falloff.
user_prompt:
[SOLAR & ATMOSPHERIC LIGHTING OVERRIDE]
SOLAR LIGHT VECTOR (4500K Late afternoon raking sunlight with warm golden highlights): Sun at camera-left (Azimuth 189.7°, Elevation 16.4°). left walls in direct sun, right walls in deep shadow. long lateral shadows project across ground to RIGHT.

[SCENE GEOMETRY & AUTHENTIC LITHICS]
High-angle architectural documentary view down London Street into Drummond Place, Edinburgh. Symmetrical Georgian residential terraces constructed from fine-grained Craigleith ashlar sandstone, detailed with V-channelled rusticated ground floors, polished ashlar upper storeys, continuous molded string courses, and mutule eaves cornices capped by stone blocking courses. Vertical load-bearing lines plumbed to absolute gravity vertical. Fenestration defined by deeply recessed 6-over-6 timber sash-and-case windows in precise grid alignments. Symmetrical dual-pitch roofs clad in diminishing-course dark grey West Highland slates, broken by multi-flue ashlar chimney stacks with terracotta cans and lead-clad dormers. Carriageways paved with dressed granite setts and whinstone kerbs bordered by Caithness flagstone footways and cast-iron spearhead railings guarding sunken basement lightwells. The central circus garden features mature Acer pseudoplatanus, Fagus sylvatica, and Ulmus glabra exhibiting November late-autumn defoliation with bare branch architecture, sparse clinging russet leaves, and evergreen Taxus baccata undergrowth. Weathered lithic surfaces show authentic coal-smoke patina in sheltered entablatures and rain-washed buff reveals on exposed profiles. Pure static survey completely devoid of vehicles, pedestrians, and clutter. Medium format 6x7 hyper-detailed architectural capture.
